conclusion.verdict: DVCH is statistically indistinguishable from standard QM at the double-slit laboratory scale. For a monochromatic source S(k) is a single constant across the screen, so beta_eff is degenerate with the overall flux normalization and is not constrained by the pattern shape; the profile chi^2 is flat over the explored range (best fit at the search boundary). This confirms the required laboratory correspondence limit of the cosmological DVCH closure.
